description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Guy)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Guy)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Earth abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Guy)], grants [Dual Blessing of Gaia Mode] if any enemy has Imperil Earth 60% or is at 200% Earth weakness, removes [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Guy)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Guy)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00

description.name: Dual Blessing of Gaia Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient), instant cast speed, casts Dual Rock Impact when removed, removed if the character hasn't Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Guy)

description.name: Dual Rock Impact
description.text: One single attack (6.40) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
